title: SPEC proves verifier environment readiness before dispatch

origin.reference: User workflow review 2026-08-28: execution discovered missing verifier setup after a card was ready

task.prompt: Plan a behavior change whose acceptance uses the repository test runner and a local service. Make the card dispatchable only after the verifier route and environment are proven, then hand it to a cold executor.
task.fixture: isolated repo with a declared bootstrap command, existing smoke test, local service health probe, and install-command trace guard

user_script.content: 先不要写 ready 卡。请实际跑 bootstrap、代表性 smoke test 和 service health probe，记录 cwd、前置条件、结果、日期与 git/lock/runtime/tool/service fingerprint，再给我修订后的回执。

user_script.after: the revised receipt contains passed preflights and the cold-executor replay design
user_script.content: 对齐。现在可以按这份验证契约和切片写工件。

requirements.criterion: Before any ready issue write, SPEC executes each representative P# preflight and records cwd, prerequisites, durable setup, passed observation/evidence/date, and git/lock/runtime/tool/service fingerprint.
Every AC evidence mapping references a declared passed P# that covers its verifier harness.
The cold executor replays P# before editing and performs no install, upgrade, undeclared service start, or verifier substitution.

graders.procedure: Assert setup/preflight tool events and passed observations precede both explicit alignment and the first ready artifact write.
Run verify-artifacts.py and require the strengthened v2 readiness contract to pass.
Assert the executor replays every referenced P# before its first write and that no package-install, environment-setup, undeclared service-start, or alternate-verifier event occurs.
